description: Confirms that recovery proceeds by ID, never by resubmitting with a fresh submitId, and that submission.state + resubmittable govern the only legal transition.
expectations: operation status is preferred when the caller only needs a snapshot
operation wait --timeout bounds only the local wait; the server keeps running
submission.state=absent + resubmittable=true escalates to the user; never auto-retries
A missing submission field is treated as 'accepted by server', not as 'absent'
Per-item state rules apply for batch operations
Recovery journal persists projectId + nodeId + submitId with mode 0600
tokens, signed URLs, cookies, or creditConfirmationToken never appear in journals
